provider: radar4kit (kit) — 600 gb per dataset, but kit-members only

free_tier.stated: Free of charge for KIT members; the usable size of temporary storage and of permanent storage for archived and published data packages is capped by a per-employee quota set in the KIT standard IT configuration (the quota figure is unverified: that page answers only from inside the KIT network); the archive system limits each dataset to 600 GB, and 50 to 100 GB per dataset is the recommended size.

identity_cost.detail: Upload needs a workspace that the KIT Library sets up for a KIT institute, research group or project team, and the service is free for KIT members. Login takes a KIT employee account, another institutional account or a registered RADAR user account; sub-curator rights can be granted to people outside KIT.
